title: More ABC
constraintsSummary: Time limit: 2 sec; Memory limit: 1024 MiB; Constraints: 1\leq T\leq 10^5; S is a string of length between 3 and 3\times 10^5, inclusive, consisting of uppercase English letters.; 1\leq K \leq 10; In each input, the total length of S over all test cases is at most 3\times 10^5.; T and K are integers.
